title: Client integration scrum — raw notes and action register
content:
Weekly scrum raw notes — Solutions Eng + ProServices sync (informal)
Date: 2029-11-20
Duration: 30m (standup style)
Attendees: Maya Patel (owner), Evan Chen (field eng), Carlos Ruiz (proservices), Leah Morgan (PM), Priya Singh (SRE), Sam Kline (solutions engineer - observer)
Slack thread: #se-proservices-onboard (refs throughout)

Purpose: quick status check across active integrations, surface new blockers, confirm action owners and short-term runway. Raw notes — not polished.

AGENDA (fast):
- Quick wins / retros from last week
- Customer-by-customer updates (10m)
- Major blockers + escalation decisions (10m)
- Actions and owners (5m)

QUICK WINS
- NorthStar Retail: first end-to-end inference call validated against test corpus (latency within 95th p50 SLA for committed load). Evan ran load harness Friday.
- Helios Health: privacy checklist accepted by their legal; started KMS onboarding. Carlos confirmed HSM test vector passed.
- Aegis Financial: routing policy POC implemented in staging; initial fallbacks exercised successfully.

CUSTOMER UPDATES (notes per customer)
1) NorthStar Retail (onboarding, midsize PLG)\- Current phase: capacity smoke + SKU mapping\- Recent: load harness run (Evan) — 10k reqs/day simulated, average p95 token latency ~220ms for baseline model; next step is quantized variant validation\- Blocker: their data engineering team needs a subnet rule changed to allow 10.0.32.0/24; ticket raised but network team at NorthStar is slow\- Action: Maya to send escalation email and propose specific CIDR + security justification. Due: 2029-11-22\- Jira refs: NS-217 (network), NS-220 (smoke test)\- Notes: remind them about request shaping for holiday spike (holiday readiness checklist link shared)

2) Helios Health (private deployment, compliance-heavy)\- Current phase: security validation -> KMS integration -> audit prep\- Recent: KMS integration tested; HSM signing validated (Carlos)\- Blocker: compliance requested FIPS-validated mode for the inference nodes; engineering needs to confirm hardware vendor support\- Decision needed: whether to schedule a short vendor call next week or provide a documented constraint (tight timeline from client)\- Action: Priya to check qualified-instance list and produce a short compatibility matrix. Due: 2029-11-23\- Linked artifacts: confluence: /Helios/Compliance-2029

3) Aegis Financial (dedicated deployment trial)\- Current phase: routing + SLAs in staging\- Recent: implemented routing policy and canary fallback to smaller quantized model; observed small quality drop in edge prompts\- Blocker: quantized variant regression in 2 prompt families — needs eval threshold tuning\- Action: Leah to run eval suite with adjusted temperature and generate sample diffs to pass to Aegis. Due: 2029-11-25\- Note: Carlos to prepare rollback playbook for the double-quantized variant in case of production degradation

4) LumenEdge (retail analytics startup — fast ramp)\- Current phase: dedicated onboarding, autoscaling config\- Recent: autoscaler rule pushed but misconfig triggers under short bursts (overprovisioning). Observed memory pressure on worker-3 during simulated flash sale test\- Blocker: possible memory leak in model server when x-batcher feature enabled. Repro steps recorded\- Action: Evan to pair with infra team (SRE) to instrument heap profiles; open PR with debug flags. Due: 2029-11-22\- Jira: LE-99 (heap), LE-102 (autoscale)

5) Meridian Education (pilot)\- Current phase: pilot -> eval metrics baseline\- Note: their curriculum evaluator found hallucination in a specific prompt template; suggested small prompt-engineering change\- Action: Sam to produce 3 prompt alternatives and run A/B micro-eval. Due: 2029-11-24

RISKS / ESCALATIONS
- Vendor hardware lead time: Helios wants FIPS-capable nodes inside 3 weeks — procurement risk if vendor lead times exceed 2 weeks (impact: schedule slip).
- Network approval delays: NorthStar CSR network gating could push go-live by >1 sprint. Need exec-chaperoned email if no response by Thursday.
- Regression windows: Aegis flagged that customer will run live validation tests on 11/28 — we must freeze model changes from 11/26–11/30 unless emergency rollback is required.

DEEP TECH NOTES (raw, for engs)
- Observed p95 token latency spikes correlate with KV cache cold-starts when request fingerprint diverges; proposed small change: increase cache warmup TTL from 60s -> 180s for customers with sustained session affinity. Priya flagged cost impact — need quick cost estimate.
- LumenEdge memory repro: happening only when x-batcher is enabled with batch_size>64 and seq_len variance >1. Repro script attached to LE-99. (Evan)
- Quantization regression: Aegis prompt family 3 triggers attention-norm drift after 200 tokens in 4-bit path. Sam suspects kernel selection mismatch; suggestion: force FP16 kernels for that prompt family as a short-term mitigation.

ACTIONS (owner + due + state) — quick register
- Maya: escalate NorthStar network request via exec-mail + propose CIDR; due 2029-11-22; state: open
- Priya: compatibility matrix for FIPS/hw; due 2029-11-23; state: open
- Leah: run Aegis eval suite with adjusted temperature + sample diffs; due 2029-11-25; state: open
- Evan: heap profiling + debug PR for LumenEdge; due 2029-11-22; state: in_progress
- Sam: 3 prompt alternatives for Meridian pilot + A/B micro-eval; due 2029-11-24; state: open
- Carlos: prepare rollback playbook for quantized variant (Aegis); due 2029-11-26; state: open

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Do we want to enable longer KV cache TTL as a customer-configurable knob in console? (pros: fewer cold start spikes; cons: cost & invalidation complexity)
- Confirm policy for production freeze windows around customer validation dates — drafting one-pager for standard cadence
- Remind sales to align expectations with NorthStar engineering (holiday ramp) — Leah to follow up with account exec

MEETING DECISIONS
- Short vendor call for Helios compatibility: yes, approved. Carlos to schedule vendor + Helios compliance next Wed.
- Freeze for Aegis: agreed — no model changes 11/26–11/30 unless emergency rollback

NEXT STEPS / NEXT MEETING
- Next sync: 2029-11-27, same time. Expect updates on NorthStar escalation, Helios compatibility matrix, and LumenEdge heap profile PR.

RAW LINKS + REFERENCES (quick)
- Onboard playbook: https://confluence.redwood-inference.internal/Onboard-Playbook-v2
- LE heap repro (internal gist): https://internal.gists/redwood/LE-heap-2029-11-19
- Aegis eval dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood-inference.internal/aegis/quant-regress
- NorthStar network ticket: https://jira.redwood-inference.internal/browse/NS-217

END OF RAW NOTES — please pull out into formal action tracker and update Confluence once blockers resolved.

(Notes to self: this doc intentionally verbose; save trimmed summary for exec digest on Friday)
